question: who was prof thomas kigabo at aims cameroon
answer: A visiting lecturer of Econometrics at AIMS-Cameroon, also a professor at the University of Rwanda's College of Business and Economics, Chief Economist at the Central Bank of Rwanda, and a member of the AIMS-Cameroon Academic Advisory Council.
